description: This source file defines structures and functions for creating shareable content payloads and constructing custom deep linking URLs for an 'OpenClaw' agent. It includes data structures for holding shared content and methods to generate message strings and URLs with specific query parameters.

methods.name: buildURL
methods.description: Constructs a deep link URL with message and additional parameters based on the provided payload and instruction.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string based on the payload and instruction, trimming the message to a maximum length.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from optional string values, returning nil if the result is empty.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Truncates a string to a specified maximum number of characters.
